name: bn-corporate-income-tax
description: Brunei corporate income tax for year of assessment 2026 (preceding-year basis, so income of the accounting period ending in 2025). Covers the 18.5% rate, the section 35(4) tax threshold for existing companies, the section 35(5) exemption for newly incorporated companies, allowable and disallowed deductions, capital allowances, tax credits, estimated chargeable income, the 30 June return, payment and late payment penalties, and withholding tax on payments to non-residents. Use for questions about company tax in Brunei Darussalam, Sdn Bhd tax, ECI, Revenue Division, OCP filing, Collector of Income Tax or Brunei withholding tax. Petroleum companies are out of scope.
